name: codex-async
description: Persistent asynchronous Codex CLI jobs for Heart Portal

tools.name: run
tools.description: Start a persistent Codex job in the background. Returns job_id immediately; use status to poll.

tools.name: resume
tools.description: Continue a completed or interrupted Codex job. The Kit reads the stored Codex session automatically.

job_id.description: The earlier Codex job to continue

cwd.description: Optional override; defaults to the earlier job

model.description: Optional override; defaults to the earlier job

sandbox.description: Optional override; defaults to the earlier job

tools.name: status
tools.description: Read a persistent job status, final answer, errors, and current Codex session ID.

tools.name: cancel
tools.description: Stop a currently running Codex job.
